notes.title: Multiplayer game mini mechanism supplement
notes.content:
In online mode, the host can set a password for the room
Online mode allows setting the number of winning sets

notes.title: 服装收集问题修复&生涯模式能力提升概率提升
notes.content:
服装收集问题修复
生涯模式能力提升成功概率随联赛等级提升

notes.title: 修复了bug
notes.content: 修复了更新后，玩家操控二传无法传到想要的位置的bug

notes.title: 新增战术要球
notes.content:
主攻的要球种类增加两种：梯次和加塞
接应在前排时增加一种：前交叉

服装收集到接近全收集时，会自动收集完剩下的服饰，并显示已全收集

notes.title: Fixed a bug where the smash of the ball was mismatched by the back row player
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the smash of the ball was mismatched by the back row player

notes.title: Ping displayed
notes.content: Ping in multiplayer mode is now displayed

notes.title: Simple rotation function in online mode
notes.content:
New simple rotation mechanism for online mode.

At present, the rotation of the two main attacks have been realized, and the rotation of the opposite and setter have been realized. The rotation between the middle blocker and the libero has not been realized.

In the previous version, the probability of the probe ball appearing was increased.

notes.title: 联机模式新增发球轮换
notes.content:
联机模式新增发球轮换（不包括位置轮换，自由人没有发球轮）。
联机模式房主无法在赛后看到名字的bug修复。
正在设计联机模式的副本模式。

notes.title: Statistics after match
notes.content:
Added online aftergame statistics.

Get one free cloth coin per day.

notes.title: Bugs fixed、Career mode reset
notes.content:
Added a function to rebind keys (located in the settings menu) 

The issue that the back row players couldn't perform first-person spikes in online mode has been resolved. 

The issue of multiple people controlling the same player in online mode has been resolved. 

After a bad pass from the setter, the attacker can now choose to hit the ball with force or not, and is no longer forced to spike. 

-----------Career Mode Reset---------
· Players can now be freely purchased in Career Mode (in scratch card form), and their attributes can be freely enhanced through skill points.
· Finishing in the top three in the league will upgrade the league level, and the opponents' ability values will gradually increase. 

Future Plans
- Add cloud save function
- Update more career mode gameplay
- Team up for cooperative dungeons in online mode

notes.title: 部分操作还原回原先版本
notes.content:
还原的操作有以下：
大师扣球模式取消了箭头；
生涯模式的人机发球取消了绝大多数失误的情况；
生涯模式的大师扣球慢动作恢复回0.5倍速；
取消了副攻因角度过偏而只能吊球的设定。
